商家号码。

- WhatsApp类型通道在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**WABA管理**>**号码管理**界面查看商家号码。

<props="intl">- Viber类型通道在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**服务号管理**界面查看Service ID。</props>
description.en:
The business phone number.

- For WhatsApp channels, view the business phone number in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **WABA Management** > **Phone Number Management** console.

<props="intl">- For Viber channels, view the Service ID in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Service Account Management** console.</props>
The message receiving status of the user.

description.zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/直客客户实例ID。在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)界面查看Space ID。
description.en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer or the instance ID of the direct customer. View the Space ID in the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) console.

description.zh: 结束时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
消息类型。取值：
- DOWN：下行消息。
- UP：上行消息。
description.en:
The message type. Valid values:
- DOWN: outbound message.
- UP: inbound message.

description.zh: 批量消息ID。您可在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**消息清单**>**批量发送清单**界面查看批量消息ID。
description.en: The bulk message ID. View the bulk message ID in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Message List** > **Bulk Sending List** console.

description.zh: 开始时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 模板编码。在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**模板设计**界面查看模板编码。
description.en: The template code. View the template code in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Template Design** console.

description.zh: 用户号码。指您在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**消息发送**界面发送消息时导入的用户号码。
description.en: The user phone number. This is the phone number that you imported when sending messages in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Message Sending** console.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口查询消息清单，也可在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**消息清单**界面进行查看。

- 该API仅支持查询WhatsApp<props="intl">、Viber</props>类型的通道消息清单。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已创建WhatsApp<props="intl">或Viber</props>类型通道；已绑定号码或商家账号 ID；已创建模板且完成审核；已使用通道发送消息。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query the message list. You can also view the message list in the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Message List** console.

- This operation only supports querying the message list for WhatsApp<props="intl"> and Viber</props> channel types.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have created a WhatsApp<props="intl"> or Viber</props> channel, bound a phone number or merchant account ID, created a template that has passed the review, and sent messages through the channel.
